criteria.evidence: workflow-faults.test.ts: every workflow action (get, ls, start, signal, cancel, cancel --dry-run) and schedule failure under --json prints {ok:false,error:{code,message,retryable,remediation?}}; code is the server data.weftCode (cli-fault.ts faultFromWireError); CLI-found failures use Unavailable, Unauthorized, Forbidden, MethodNotFound, InvalidParams, NotFound.

renderFault prints the message then a Try: line when remediation is present; exit codes unchanged (workflow-mutations, workflow-lifecycle, schedule tests pass unchanged; workflow-faults.test.ts asserts exit 2 plus Try line, and no Try line when absent).

tool-faults.test.ts: the seven built-in tools and workflow tools return isError:true, structuredContent {code,message,retryable,remediation?} and the message as text; verified through the SDK server with an in-process client (mcp/server.ts forwards structuredContent).
packages/weft/src/cli/__fixtures__/workflow-get-not-found.golden.json pins the JSON error of weft workflow get --json for a missing workflow, asserted in workflow-faults.test.ts.
